title: European infrastructure is vulnerable as Putin escalates Russia’s hybrid war
gist: Russia's hybrid war against Europe is escalating toward civilian infrastructure, with sabotage of Starlink sites, mapping of undersea cables, drone incidents and cyberattacks on grids and utilities. The author argues Europe's integrated, peacetime-designed infrastructure is its weakest link as Putin seeks to cut Ukraine's European aid lifeline.
